_comment: Per-(stem, preset) drift: `axteam/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8-dynamic` @ 6349d56f quantizes every Linear fp8-per-channel except what its own `quantization_config.ignore` lists, and that list is these 11 entries, verbatim. Ten are compressed-tensors regexes (`re:` prefix, `re.match` against the full checkpoint module path), which `storage_format_for_weight` matches as such. Unlike Qwen3.6 it QUANTIZES the GDN projections (`linear_attn.in_proj_{qkv,z,a,b}`, `out_proj`); it leaves the embeddings, lm_head, routers/gates, norms, the vision tower, the MTP head and the GDN conv1d/A_log/dt_bias in bf16.
